stages.requirement: Record the model/tool and contribution level for each generated or AI-assisted section, then disclose the assistance accurately when material to the customer's understanding.
prohibited: generic disclosure that falsely claims a specific model/tool was used
claiming local inference when cloud inference was used
claiming independent verification when the arithmetic or source was not independently checked

stages.requirement: Preserve a genuine operator-authored line, judgment, decision, or experience supplied by the operator and linked to its source. Do not invent first-person, sensory, autobiographical, customer, or testimonial detail.
prohibited: adding sensory details merely to make copy appear human
treating a style score as proof of human authorship

stages.requirement: Edits may improve clarity, rhythm, concision, and remove formulaic phrasing only when they preserve meaning and factual scope. Do not rewrite to evade AI detectors or conceal AI involvement.
prohibited: removal of caveats that materially affect truth
style changes that erase an operator's deliberate sharpness or uncertainty

decision_rules.reason: AI contribution or source provenance is incomplete.
A required human voice anchor is absent or not operator-confirmed.
The artifact invents personal or customer experience.
The edit changes factual scope, confidence, or material caveats.
The objective is to conceal AI authorship or game a detector.
Disclosure contradicts recorded model, tool, or contribution provenance.

local_first_for: sensitive evidence analysis where the local model is suitable
free_cloud_permitted_for: non-sensitive reasoning within the provider's free tier and terms
zero_budget_inference_policy.paid_cloud: DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT until the user explicitly approves spending after verified revenue or another stated funding source.
zero_budget_inference_policy.provider_claims: Model names, limits, prices, free-tier availability, and availability must be checked at use time. Never hard-code transient vendor marketing claims as policy facts.
zero_budget_inference_policy.boundary: Local model output is not a source of economic truth. Deterministic code and external evidence remain authoritative.

learning_mode.privacy: Record concise decisions and evidence, not hidden chain-of-thought.
